correctness.rationale: Exact integer-threshold graph-ball facet rule is from arXiv:2212.05871 Lemma 2.2. N_1[x] equals the complement of P_i minus x, hence at scale two a face exists iff a part occupancy is at most one. Decompose T_j into two contractible joins with intersection T_{j-1}*D_j; homotopy pushout gives T_j ≃ Σ(T_{j-1}*D_j), and induction gives the sphere wedge. Mayer–Vietoris naturality and integral join Künneth give the augmentation tensor module. Graph cycle rank and full scale-three simplex yield the barcode. Finite independent bitset boundary computations for eight tuple cases returned VERIFY_OK, corroborating rather than replacing the infinite proof. No boundary case with k<2 or singleton parts is included.
